The extension already builds, links, imports, and 10/11 optimizers run; you are hunting LATENT on-device correctness bugs (especially on code paths the grokking race does not exercise, and numeric errors).

 - the binding that calls it: grep csrc/bindings/bindings.cpp for the relevant launch_/op name to see the Python->C++ dtype/shape contract.
 - Optionally the Python optimizer grokking_optimizers/optimizers/transformer_decoder.py to see what dtypes/shapes it actually passes.


KNOWN BUG CLASSES already confirmed on this H100 (look for MORE of the same):
 (A) Mixed-dtype paired tensors into a single-template kernel: the kernel
     dispatches on ONE tensor's scalar_type() (e.g. weight) then reads a PAIRED
     tensor (e.g. its bias) with data_ptr<SAME_T>(). If Python can pass them in
     different dtypes (weight bf16 via projection_precision='bf16', bias left
     fp32) -> "expected BFloat16 but found Float" at runtime. (Confirmed: SG2
     input_proj_W bf16 vs input_proj_b fp32.)
 (B) Wrong count/loop-bound: a kernel loops 't < n_tasks' or indexes arr[t]
     where n_tasks / the size were set to the ELEMENT count instead of the
     TASK/entry count, walking a small array out of bounds. (Confirmed: fused_step
     n_tasks=n.)
 (C) at:: host ops mixing bf16 weights with fp32 activations without a .to()
     coercion (e.g. a.matmul(b) where a is bf16 and b fp32).
 (D) reshape/view({-1, K}) where the tensor numel may not be divisible by K
     (dimension-wiring mismatch between the passed config int and the actual
     tensor shape). (Confirmed: SG2 meta-net '[-1,44]' vs numel 192.)
 (E) Missing __syncthreads()/__syncwarp() between dependent shared-memory phases,
     or a grid/block index that can exceed the allocated buffer.
 (F) Numeric divergence from the canonical algorithm header (wrong formula,
     swapped operands, missing bias-correction, wrong beta, etc.).


Method: read the kernel fully. For every kernel that dispatches on a tensor dtype, check that ALL tensors it reads with data_ptr<T>() under that branch are guaranteed that dtype. For every reshape/index, check the dimension is derivable and divides. For optimizer kernels, verify the per-element update matches the canonical header formula EXACTLY (operand order, bias-correction, eps placement). 

Report ONLY findings you can back with a specific code snippet and a concrete reachability argument. Prefer precision over recall: a 'certain' high-severity finding is worth far more than ten speculative ones. If the kernel looks correct, return an empty findings array — that is a valid, valuable result. Return the structured object.

306	// ─── Atomic-add-on-W helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────
307	// FP32: builtin atomicAdd. BF16/FP16: simulate via CAS on uint16 packed
308	// pairs (slow path; only used for embedding/bias gradients which are
309	// small). Acceptable for grokking-scale (vocab=99, d=128).
310	__device__ __forceinline__ void atomic_add_w(float* p, float v) { atomicAdd(p, v); }
311	__device__ __forceinline__ void atomic_add_w(__nv_bfloat16* p, float v) {
312	    // Atomic on aligned uint32 holding two BF16s
313	    auto* p_align = reinterpret_cast<unsigned int*>(
314	        reinterpret_cast<size_t>(p) & ~(size_t)0x3);
315	    bool is_high = (reinterpret_cast<size_t>(p) & 0x3) != 0;
316	    unsigned int old = *p_align, expected;
317	    do {
318	        expected = old;
319	        unsigned int half = is_high ? (expected >> 16) : (expected & 0xFFFF);
320	        __nv_bfloat16 cur = __ushort_as_bfloat16((unsigned short)half);
321	        float new_val = __bfloat162float(cur) + v;
322	        unsigned short new_bits = __bfloat16_as_ushort(__float2bfloat16(new_val));
323	        unsigned int packed = is_high
324	            ? ((expected & 0xFFFFu) | ((unsigned int)new_bits << 16))
325	            : ((expected & 0xFFFF0000u) | (unsigned int)new_bits);
326	        old = atomicCAS(p_align, expected, packed);
327	    } while (old != expected);
328	}
329	__device__ __forceinline__ void atomic_add_w(__half* p, float v) {
330	    auto* p_align = reinterpret_cast<unsigned int*>(
331	        reinterpret_cast<size_t>(p) & ~(size_t)0x3);
332	    bool is_high = (reinterpret_cast<size_t>(p) & 0x3) != 0;
333	    unsigned int old = *p_align, expected;
334	    do {
335	        expected = old;
336	        unsigned int half = is_high ? (expected >> 16) : (expected & 0xFFFF);
337	        __half cur = __ushort_as_half((unsigned short)half);
338	        float new_val = __half2float(cur) + v;
339	        unsigned short new_bits = __half_as_ushort(__float2half(new_val));
340	        unsigned int packed = is_high
341	            ? ((expected & 0xFFFFu) | ((unsigned int)new_bits << 16))
342	            : ((expected & 0xFFFF0000u) | (unsigned int)new_bits);
343	        old = atomicCAS(p_align, expected, packed);
344	    } while (old != expected);
345	}

358	template <typename T>
359	inline ActLayout<T> compute_layout(int B, int S, int D, int H, int V, int ffn_exp) {
360	    const size_t bsd = (size_t)B * S * D;
361	    const size_t bs3d = (size_t)B * S * 3 * D;
362	    const size_t bshd = (size_t)B * S * (size_t)ffn_exp * D;
363	    const size_t bhs = (size_t)B * H * S;
364	    const size_t bsv = (size_t)B * S * V;
365	    const size_t lse_T = (bhs * sizeof(float) + sizeof(T) - 1) / sizeof(T);
366	    ActLayout<T> L;
367	    L.input_ids_saved = (size_t)B * S;
368	    L.qkv_in = bsd;
369	    L.qkv_out = bs3d;
370	    L.attn_in_qkv = bs3d;       // packed q,k,v in [B,H,S,d] each = bsd*3
371	    L.attn_out_perhead = bsd;
372	    L.attn_out = bsd;
373	    L.attn_proj = bsd;
374	    L.n1_in = bsd;
375	    L.layer1_out = bsd;
376	    L.ffn_pre = bshd;
377	    L.ffn_post = bshd;
378	    L.ffn_out = bsd;
379	    L.n2_in = bsd;
380	    L.layer_out = bsd;
381	    L.softmax_lse_T = lse_T;
382	    L.per_layer_total =
383	        L.qkv_in + L.qkv_out + L.attn_in_qkv + L.attn_out_perhead +
384	        L.attn_out + L.attn_proj + L.n1_in + L.layer1_out +
385	        L.ffn_pre + L.ffn_post + L.ffn_out + L.n2_in + L.layer_out +
386	        L.softmax_lse_T;
387	    L.embed_out = bsd;
388	    L.final_norm_out = bsd;
389	    L.logits_full = bsv;
390	    return L;
391	}

548	template <typename T, typename W>
549	__global__ void __launch_bounds__(128, 4)
550	residual_layernorm_kernel(
551	    const T* __restrict__ x, const T* __restrict__ residual,
552	    const W* __restrict__ gain, const W* __restrict__ bias,
553	    T* __restrict__ sum_out, T* __restrict__ out,
554	    int N, int D, float eps
555	) {
556	    const int row = blockIdx.x;
557	    if (row >= N) return;
558	    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
559	    const int row_off = row * D;
560	
561	    extern __shared__ float smem[];
562	    float* sum_buf = smem;
563	
564	    float local_sum = 0.0f;
565	    for (int d = tid; d < D; d += blockDim.x) {
566	        float v = to_float<T>(x[row_off + d]) + to_float<T>(residual[row_off + d]);
567	        sum_buf[d] = v;
568	        sum_out[row_off + d] = from_float<T>(v);
569	        local_sum += v;
570	    }
571	    __shared__ float reduce_buf[32];
572	    int lane = tid & (WARP_SIZE - 1);
573	    int warp = tid / WARP_SIZE;
574	    local_sum = warp_reduce_sum(local_sum, WARP_SIZE, lane);
575	    if (lane == 0) reduce_buf[warp] = local_sum;
576	    __syncthreads();
577	    int n_warps = (blockDim.x + WARP_SIZE - 1) / WARP_SIZE;
578	    float total_sum = (tid < n_warps) ? reduce_buf[tid] : 0.0f;
579	    total_sum = warp_reduce_sum(total_sum, n_warps, tid);
580	    if (tid == 0) reduce_buf[0] = total_sum;
581	    __syncthreads();
582	    float mean = reduce_buf[0] / (float)D;
583	
584	    float local_var = 0.0f;
585	    for (int d = tid; d < D; d += blockDim.x) {
586	        float v = sum_buf[d] - mean;
587	        local_var += v * v;
588	    }
589	    local_var = warp_reduce_sum(local_var, WARP_SIZE, lane);
590	    if (lane == 0) reduce_buf[warp] = local_var;
591	    __syncthreads();
592	    float total_var = (tid < n_warps) ? reduce_buf[tid] : 0.0f;
593	    total_var = warp_reduce_sum(total_var, n_warps, tid);
594	    if (tid == 0) reduce_buf[0] = total_var;
595	    __syncthreads();
596	    float inv_std = fast_rsqrt_nr(reduce_buf[0] / (float)D + eps);

598	    for (int d = tid; d < D; d += blockDim.x) {
599	        float g = to_float<W>(gain[d]);
600	        float b = to_float<W>(bias[d]);
601	        float v = (sum_buf[d] - mean) * inv_std;
602	        out[row_off + d] = from_float<T>(v * g + b);
603	    }

def decoder_forward(tokens, weights: DecoderWeights, cfg: ModelConfig):
    """Decoder Transformer forward pass.

    Embedding + positional -> L layers of (LN + causal attention + LN + FFN
    with GELU) -> final LN -> last-token logits via vocab head.

    Args:
        tokens: [batch, seq_len] integer token ids
        weights: DecoderWeights named tuple
        cfg: ModelConfig

    Returns:
        logits: [batch, vocab_size] logits from the last token position
    """
    B, S = tokens.shape
    hd = cfg.n_heads * cfg.d_head

    # Embedding + positional
    x = weights.embed[tokens] + weights.pos_embed[None, :S, :]  # [B, S, d_model]

    saved_activations = []
    for layer in range(cfg.n_layers):
        # Pre-LN attention
        x_ln = _layer_norm(x, weights.ln_attn_gamma[layer], weights.ln_attn_beta[layer])
        qkv = x_ln @ weights.w_qkv[layer]  # [B, S, 3*hd]
        q, k, v = jnp.split(qkv, 3, axis=-1)  # each [B, S, hd]

        # Reshape to [B, n_heads, S, d_head]
        q = q.reshape(B, S, cfg.n_heads, cfg.d_head).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
        k = k.reshape(B, S, cfg.n_heads, cfg.d_head).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
        v = v.reshape(B, S, cfg.n_heads, cfg.d_head).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)

        attn_out, _ = attention_forward(q, k, v, causal=True)
        attn_out = attn_out.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, S, hd)  # [B, S, hd]
        attn_out = attn_out @ weights.w_o[layer]  # [B, S, d_model]
        x = x + attn_out

        # Pre-LN FFN
        x_ln2 = _layer_norm(x, weights.ln_ffn_gamma[layer], weights.ln_ffn_beta[layer])
        hidden = jax.nn.gelu(x_ln2 @ weights.w_up[layer])
        ffn_out = hidden @ weights.w_down[layer]
        x = x + ffn_out

        saved_activations.append(x)

    # Final LN + last-token logits
    x = _layer_norm(x, weights.ln_final_gamma, weights.ln_final_beta)
    last_token = x[:, -1, :]  # [B, d_model]
    logits = last_token @ weights.w_vocab  # [B, vocab_size]
    return logits
